description: Defines the AccountSummaryCollectionData class, an immutable data object that encapsulates collections of various account summaries such as loans, savings, shares, and guarantor accounts. It provides constructors to initialize the data with proper defaults and private helper methods to handle null or empty collections.

classes.name: AccountSummaryCollectionData
classes.description: An immutable data container for different types of account summaries, including loans, savings, shares, and guarantor-related accounts. It includes constructors for initializing these collections and private methods for default handling.

methods.name: AccountSummaryCollectionData
